name: GKA-primed-HQwen3-32B-Reasoner
context_scaling: Native 131,072 positions, not the base's 40,960: the Priming pipeline converts half the stack to fixed-state GKA layers and the repo publishes 128K long-context reasoning support (config.json max_position_embeddings 131072, rope_theta 5e6). Not a sliding-window recipe.
attention_variant: Hybrid Attention + Gated KalmaNet: 32 of 64 layers are full GQA attention and 32 are GKA SSM layers (fixed-size recurrent state, no growing KV), per config.json hybrid_override_pattern. GKA layer indices chosen by the authors' selective-hybridization procedure; runtime num_iter knob trades compute for accuracy. Only the 32 attention layers carry KV, so KV/token is half the base's.
notes: ADDED 2026-10-29. A hybrid derivative of Qwen/Qwen3-32B, not a new base model: same hidden_size 5120, 64 layers, 8 KV heads, head_dim 128, but half the attention layers are converted to Gated KalmaNet SSM layers by the awslabs Hybrid Model Factory priming pipeline. Recorded as a contender because it publishes a full same-table benchmark comparison against its own base; rows below are card-sourced and marked vendor_claim. It loses BFCLv3 and SciCode.
